spawn_scatter.doc: How far, in map units, a character lands from the spawn point it entered at: a random point inside a circle of this radius, on that point's plane, so arrivals into an outpost are spread over the area instead of stacking on one spot. An outpost arrival first takes a random point of the map's own spawn list (the pack's spawns.json), then this circle decides where in it the character stands. Zero puts every arrival exactly on the point's coordinate.
